verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only contains generic SSO overview statements and unrelated MCP/SCIM/event-hook docs; there is no documented walkthrough for configuring custom SAML, OIDC, or header-based (SWA) apps outside the catalog. Missing for 10: specific admin guides for adding custom SAML app integrations, custom OIDC app integrations, and header-based/SWA app configuration steps.
